runtimeMapping.normal: One Physical target, ground/air. Native Attack .533 with maxAnimScale1; tracked speed5, no splash. Normal target selected at attack start; fired projectile survives source retreat.
runtimeMapping.S1: Automatic offensive-SP next ground attack. Native Skill .6 event/maxAnimScale1; release targets are re-evaluated, missing ground target returns the spent charge. Fixed point speed3 throw, cached release ATK, selected projectile_range radius and projectile_delay_time dwell. Per-recipient first .9 then1s source-less Arts DOT and strongest Enfeeble while in field.
runtimeMapping.S2: Manual throw with one or two charges as selected source rank specifies. Native Skill_2 .567 release/1.5 cast duration/maxAnimScale1, source range enemy branch else random range tile. Landing point remains fixed, radius/dwell from all source ranks, overlapping field buffs independent. Enemies receive source-less periodic Arts, allies receive HP_RECOVERY_PER_SEC derived buff not periodic HealAbility.
runtimeMapping.talent: E2/potential-selected skill@damage_scale increases BUFF/continuous damage from any source to ground enemies in fields; highest multiplier once across overlapping fields. IS-only Hope/Toil talent has no regular battle effect.
runtimeMapping.lifetime: Owner death/retreat before release cancels cast. Fired projectile and landed fields finish independent of owner. Buffs detach on recipient leaving/hidden/death or field expiry.

verificationLimits: Native compiled alchemist controller cache_atk construction, parameter remapping and projectile_range collider rescaling are not recovered; local fields snapshot live ATK at projectile release, damage multiplies atk_scale and regeneration multiplies hp_recovery_per_sec_ratio separately. No outgoing attacker multipliers or penetration apply to NoSourceDamage.

Native S2 tile filter29 comparator and Parallel branch scheduling are unavailable; local adapter prioritizes a current ground enemy at release, otherwise picks a random existing stage tile in attack range. Exact native tile weighting, target root versus current position and target-death/refund dispatch are unverified.

Native firstTriggerInterval .899999976 and interval1 are preserved as .9/1s per-recipient clocks. Collision attach/detach and projectile completion order use simulation steps; native frame/callback parity is unverified.

S1 derived loadFromDB attr_down[atk][inf] database base definition is not recovered. Local adapter uses existing strongest-value Enfeeble status with at most one simulation step of exit persistence. Native cross-source override priority remains unverified.

S2 native HP_RECOVERY_PER_SEC is implemented through simulator hpRegen. Its shared regeneration pipeline currently applies existing recipient healing modifiers; exact native regeneration modifier handling remains unverified. Fields overlap as independent disableOverride1 parents; exact native periodic-parent cleanup ordering is unavailable.

Native talent filters attackType BUFF; simulator tagged DOT models the continuous damage subset. Other unimplemented BUFF attack classifications remain unsupported; instantaneous attacks/bursts do not receive the modifier.
Native particle/audio fields and Unity parabolic mover curves are not rendered. Original operator skeleton facings are byte-verified; modules, IS mode and game-frame fidelity are not claimed.
